description: Internal definitions and inline functions for managing ARC MPU v4 regions, including dynamic region handling, configuration, and MPU control functions within Zephyr OS.

classes.name: dynamic_region_info
classes.description: Structure holding information about dynamically configurable MPU regions.

methods.name: _region_init
methods.description: Initializes an MPU region with specified address, size, and attributes.

methods.name: _region_set_attr
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specified MPU region.

methods.name: _region_get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: _region_get_start
methods.description: Gets the start address of an MPU region.

methods.name: _region_set_start
methods.description: Sets the start address of an MPU region.

methods.name: _region_get_end
methods.description: Gets the end address of an MPU region.

methods.name: _region_set_end
methods.description: Sets the end address of an MPU region.

methods.name: _mpu_probe
methods.description: Probes the MPU to find the region index for a given address.

methods.name: _get_region_index
methods.description: Finds the MPU region index matching a start address and size.

methods.name: _dynamic_region_allocate_index
methods.description: Allocates an index for a dynamic MPU region.

methods.name: _dynamic_region_allocate_and_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a dynamic MPU region with base, size, and attributes.

methods.name: _mpu_reset_dynamic_regions
methods.description: Resets all dynamic MPU regions to default.

methods.name: _mpu_configure
methods.description: Configures an MPU region based on type, base, and size.

methods.name: arc_mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes the MPU with configured regions during system startup.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_enable
methods.description: Enables the MPU.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_disable
methods.description: Disables the MPU (by setting default region).

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_configure_thread
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a thread, including stack guard and memory domain.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_default
methods.description: Sets the default MPU region attributes.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_region
methods.description: Configures a specific MPU region with base, size, and attributes.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_configure_mem_domain
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a thread's memory domain partitions.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_remove_mem_domain
methods.description: Removes MPU regions associated with a memory domain.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_remove_mem_partition
methods.description: Removes a specific memory partition's MPU region.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_get_max_domain_partition_regions
methods.description: Returns maximum number of regions available for memory domain partitions.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer is accessible for user or kernel.
